Package io.telekom.orchest.cache.core

Interface CacheHooks<K,V>

Type Parameters:
K - key type
V - cached value type
public interface CacheHooks<K,V>
Extension points fired around each refresh cycle. Default methods are no-ops so hosts only override what they need. Hooks run on the refresh thread — keep them cheap.
